neighbours.label: a middle item in a comma-separated series, or 'too' set off by commas
fire: She acted in film, television, theatre and opera.
By evening the dogs, too, were exhausted.
He sold shoes, hats, belts and scarves at the fair.
The mice, too, had escaped from the lab.
They toured Spain, Italy, Greece and Turkey.
I wrote for blogs, newspapers, journals and radio.
My brother, too, was born in that hospital.
We need flour, sugar, butter and eggs.
quiet: She acted in film and later in opera.
By evening the dogs were also exhausted.
He sold shoes at the fair.
The mice had also escaped from the lab.
They toured Spain and later Turkey.
I wrote for a newspaper for many years.
My brother was also born in that hospital.
We need flour for the cake.
